|errata_history=This is version PC-E2 (3 of 3), 9 March 2026. It is the current text. The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Original''' ([[How Liberty Dies]]): PC card image of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-hld-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7821822/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/howlibertydies.gif howlibertydies.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/7821822 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark.  The same text is printed on the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF built 10 August 2025, page 8). Text: “Deploy on Galactic Senate. Your Political Effects are canceled. Twice per turn, may target your agenda here: Justice: During battle, subtract 1 from a just drawn weapon destiny. Order: During any move phase, peek at the top 2 cards of any Reserve Deck and replace in any order. Peace: Subtract 1 from attrition against you. Taxation: Place a card with no printed destiny number > 4 from hand in Used Pile to activate 1 Force.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[How Liberty Dies (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 8, file created 10 August 2025: “Deploy on Galactic Senate. Your Political Effects are canceled. Twice per turn, may target your agenda here: Justice: During battle, subtract 1 from a just drawn weapon destiny. Order: During any move phase, peek at the top 2 cards of any Reserve Deck and replace in any order. Peace: Subtract 1 from attrition against you. Taxation: Place a card with no printed destiny number &gt; 4 from hand in Used Pile to activate 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[How Liberty Dies]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[How Liberty Dies]] (published 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•How Liberty Dies”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC card image of 9 March 2026<ref name="ht-hld-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e07/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/howlibertydies.gif howlibertydies.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6f23e07 6f23e07] (9 March 2026).</ref>, marked “E1”. What changed from the previous image: PC Tweak Set errata (marked “E1”): Taxation now reads “Place a character with politics from hand in Used Pile to choose: Activate 1 Force or ▼ Senate Hovercam.” (was “Place a card with no printed destiny number > 4 from hand in Used Pile to activate 1 Force.”). Text: “Deploy on Galactic Senate. Your Political Effects are canceled. Twice per turn, may target your agenda here: Justice: During battle, subtract 1 from a just drawn weapon destiny. Taxation: Place a character with politics from hand in Used Pile to choose: Activate 1 Force or ▼ Senate Hovercam.”

* Justice's 'subtract 1 from a weapon destiny' is not cumulative on the same weapon destiny, but would be effective against a weapon that draws two weapon destiny (by subtracting 1 from each draw).
